title: Impact of Political Television Advertisements on Viewers’ Response to Subsequent Advertisements
authors: Beth L. Fossen; Girish Mallapragada; Anwesha De
eligible_reason: Ad-airing-level regressions of log post-ad audience on an indicator that the ad airs immediately after a political ad, with creative, program, category, day-of-week and half-hour FE plus the pre-ad audience (lagged outcome) and ad-break controls. The treatment is an observation-level indicator, not a unit adopting at a date; no DiD.
design_notes: 'Replication R Model Code.txt': lm.cluster(LOG_RATPOST ~ factor(CREATIVE_ID) + factor(PROGRAM) + factor(CATEGORY) + factor(DOW) + factor(TIME_HALFHOUR) + PROG_TYPE + AD_POSITION + ADS_IN_BREAK + DAYS_TILL_ELECTION + AD_LENGTH + BREAK_POSITION + LOG_RATPRE + AFTER_POLITICAL_AD, cluster = BRAND_ID); Models 2-6 split AFTER_POLITICAL_AD by attack/party/sponsor/position.
data_files_note: 43,089 ad-airing rows; the file lacks CATEGORY and DOW, which the model code uses.
data_provenance_note: Ad-airing audience data; no masking stated; two FE variables used by the code are missing from the file.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary or empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
